description: Five Minecraft players repair a bridge. Chat is disabled. The visible incident escalates from staring to gesture, invasion of space, and object damage within one scenario.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places three stone slabs on Riley's bridge side, adds one fence rail, and steps to the side to inspect the bridge.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stops building and faces Riley for several seconds. Morgan then crouches repeatedly twice and swings an empty hand toward Riley's fence rail. Riley steps two blocks away to the side of the bridge. Morgan follows into the same side space and stands one block from Riley. Morgan then breaks two stone slabs Riley placed, breaks Riley's fence rail, and stands on the gap left in Riley's bridge side.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves between Riley and Morgan, steps onto the gap, places two stone slabs to restore the bridge, re-places the fence rail at the centerline, and stands on the inner edge of the fence facing Morgan.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the shared chest, takes three stone slabs and one fence, steps to the safe edge of the gap, places two slabs to cover the hole, adds one fence rail on the repaired edge, then steps back to the observer line.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to the gap, places temporary stone slabs to restore the walkway, picks up the dropped fence item, replaces the fence where it was removed, then drops two equal stacks of slabs at the bridge midpoint before resuming repair on the central span.

target_reaction: Riley slides back three blocks toward the bridge edge, turns gaze down to avoid eye contact, then sidesteps along the bridge rim toward the shared chest, keeping two blocks of distance from Morgan. Riley skirts past the center line, pauses near Casey’s side, takes a small stack of slabs from the shared chest, and moves to an unobstructed section two blocks away from both Morgan and the gap before placing a single stone slab to begin a quiet repair.
